visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged man with short hair and glasses wearing a black button-down shirt stands in a brightly lit studio. He speaks directly to the camera with expressive hand gestures. Behind him are wooden bookshelves filled with various books and a green potted plant on the left. High-energy yellow text overlays appear at the top of the frame. (2) A series of clips showing a car driving through a sunny city intersection, a close-up of a bare foot pressing a car's brake pedal, and a headshot of a smiling female scientist (Shadi Doroudgar) against a white background. A digital interface shows a cognitive test with a red dot changing to a green circle. (3) The man continues his presentation with infographics showing icons of a young man and an elderly man along with reaction time statistics. A detailed diagram of a human brain appears, highlighting the prefrontal cortex in orange. The man uses his hands to demonstrate cognitive load and mental bottlenecks. (4) Footage of a professional driving simulation lab. An elderly person in a light blue shirt and helmet sits on a white scooter in front of three large monitors displaying a 3D street scene. A male technician in a blue polo shirt assists. (5) Bar charts appear on screen comparing mirror checks and signal use before and after training, showing dramatic improvement. The host returns for a final summary, pointing downwards towards a call-to-action button while large white arrows flash.
